discovery_initial: Original fresh_v1 discovery seeds in ascending order, selected independently within each model and mode.
discovery_eligibility: Registered Enumeration grammar, one-to-one ordered gold items, and ten legal item endpoints. No final-answer correctness or intervention-outcome filter.
reserve_rule: Freeze and generate all sixty N=10 reserve inputs for both Gemma formats; append eligible seeds in ascending order until each discovery cohort has twenty. Do not borrow confirmation candidates, extend the pool, or select by readout or patching outcomes.

capture.site: Post-block residual at the last token of each of ten items, before prompt-filler deletion

selection.primary: pooled out-of-fold NCC balanced accuracy, no shrinkage

confirmation: Reuse the ten frozen primary Update seeds independently per model and mode. These are reused confirmation inputs; original interventions have already been observed. Capture selected-layer states and report discovery-fitted NCC/logistic readout without reselecting the layer.
queue: After fresh_retrieve_gpu_v2 completes, run reserve baselines, discovery preparation/capture/selection for all four cells, freeze the combined selection, then selected-layer confirmation readout, all Update technical smokes, and all formal Update jobs. Replace the unstarted seven-layer diagnostic; never interrupt healthy primary GPU work.
chronology: User-requested protocol amendment after mixed-N Update outcomes were observed. Selection uses only N=10 discovery states; retain all previous results and explicitly disclose reused confirmation inputs.
scope: Update-specific layer selection, selected-layer readout and the four Update grids. Full-cohort geometry, Retrieve, Read blanking, answer-state and relay retain their assay-specific populations as in Thinking.
